cleaned_text.text:
Name: Minji Kim

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Research Intern, Korea Institute for Economic Policy. Assisted senior economists in collecting and analyzing macroeconomic data related to South Korea's fiscal policy. Conducted literature reviews on recent trends in global economic development, focusing on the impacts of monetary interventions. Developed econometric models using Stata to forecast GDP growth under various policy scenarios. Prepared visualizations and presentations for internal meetings, translating complex quantitative findings into accessible summaries. Collaborated with a team to draft sections of a policy brief intended for government stakeholders, ensuring accuracy and clarity in economic recommendations.

Education:
- 2021--2023: M.A. in Economics, Seoul National University. Main courses: Advanced Microeconomics, Econometrics, International Trade Theory, Development Ec
